title: 广交会的房东
title_py: guǎng jiāo huì de fáng dōng
title_en: The landlady at the Canton Fair

lines.text: 每年春天和秋天，广州都会举办广交会，来自世界各地的采购商成千上万。
lines.py: měi nián chūn tiān hé qiū tiān, guǎng zhōu dōu huì jǔ bàn guǎng jiāo huì, lái zì shì jiè gè dì de cǎi gòu shāng chéng qiān shàng wàn.
lines.en: Every spring and autumn, Guangzhou holds the Canton Fair, and buyers come in their tens of thousands from all over the world.

lines.text: 今年秋天，周经理带杰克去参加展会，可是酒店订晚了，展馆附近的酒店早就订满了，剩下的一晚要两千多块。
lines.py: jīn nián qiū tiān, Zhōu jīng lǐ dài Jié kè qù cān jiā zhǎn huì, kě shì jiǔ diàn dìng wǎn le, zhǎn guǎn fù jìn de jiǔ diàn zǎo jiù dìng mǎn le, shèng xià de yì wǎn yào liǎng qiān duō kuài.
lines.en: This autumn, Manager Zhou takes Jack to exhibit at the fair, but they've booked too late: the hotels near the exhibition halls are long since full, and what's left costs over two thousand yuan a night.

lines.text: 一位广州的老客户给他们出了个主意：“住本地人家里吧。广交会的时候，很多老广州人都把空房间租给客人。”

lines.en: An old client in Guangzhou gives them an idea. "Stay with a local family. During the fair, lots of old Guangzhou families rent out their spare rooms."
